seoTitle: How to Connect Google Drive to Claude.ai and Query Your Files
metaDescription: Connect the Google Drive connector to Claude.ai from Customize > Connectors: what Claude can read, what it can create, and where the setup breaks.
intro: Connecting Google Drive to Claude lets you ask questions about files already sitting in your Drive instead of opening each one yourself. The setup lives under Customize, not Settings, and it grants Claude more than read access: once connected, Claude can search your Drive, read what it finds, and create new files there too. This guide covers where the connector actually lives, what the Google sign-in screen asks you to approve, and the difference between turning the connector on for Claude to search on its own versus attaching one specific file to a chat.
prerequisites: A Google account with files already in Drive
On Team or Enterprise plans, an Owner must add Google Drive to the workspace's connector list before it shows up for members

steps.heading: Open Customize > Connectors
steps.body: In claude.ai, go to Customize, the page that holds your connectors, skills, and plugins. This is not under Settings, despite that being the more obvious guess. Find Google Drive in the list and select Connect. On Team and Enterprise plans, Google Drive won't appear here at all until an Owner has enabled it for the organization; each member then connects their own Google account separately.

image.caption: Claude's Connectors page under Customize, showing Canva, Figma, and GitHub already connected. Google Drive gets added the same way.

steps.heading: Sign in to Google and grant the requested permissions
steps.body: Selecting Connect opens Google's own "Choose an account" screen. Pick the account whose Drive you want Claude to reach, or sign in first if you're not already authenticated in that browser. Read what Google says Claude is requesting before continuing: the connector isn't read-only. Claude can search your Drive, read the files it finds, and create new files there, so this is a broader grant than a simple viewer permission.

image.caption: Google's account picker for the Claude connector, the point where you choose which account's files Claude will be able to reach.

steps.heading: Turn the connector on inside a conversation
steps.body: Connecting the account once doesn't make Drive searchable everywhere by default. In a chat, select the + at the lower left of the message box, choose Connectors, and turn on Google Drive for that conversation. Claude can then search your Drive on its own and will ask for your approval before it uses one of the connector's tools.

steps.heading: Ask a question that needs your files, or attach one directly
steps.body: With the connector on, ask something like "find the design brief for the onboarding project and summarize the open decisions." If you'd rather point Claude at one specific document instead of letting it search, use the same + menu and select Add from Google Drive, then search by name or paste the file's URL. That route works for Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides, and it re-reads the file's current content from Drive every time you send a message. Adding a Drive file to a project's knowledge, rather than a single chat, only works in a private project — the option is dimmed in a shared one.

steps.heading: Reconnect or remove it later
steps.body: Everything about the connector after setup lives back on the same Customize > Connectors page. Select Google Drive under Your connectors to Disconnect, Reconnect, or use the three-dot menu to Remove it entirely. If a reconnection error keeps recurring, disconnect, then connect and sign in to Google again rather than repeating the same reconnect attempt.

tables.title: File types Claude can read through the connector
rows: A file's comments or suggested edits
tables.note: Very large files may come through incomplete regardless of type.

troubleshooting.problem: Claude can't find or use a file even though the connector is on
troubleshooting.cause: The file is over Google's roughly 10 MB export cap for Docs, Sheets, and Slides, or it's a very large file whose content Claude receives incomplete.
troubleshooting.fix: Check the file's size, or attach it directly via + > Add from Google Drive and confirm Claude reports reading its content.

troubleshooting.problem: The Google Drive option is dimmed when adding files to a project
troubleshooting.cause: Drive files can only be added to a project's knowledge in a private project, not a shared one.
troubleshooting.fix: Add the file to a private project, or use the connector inside an individual chat instead.

troubleshooting.problem: Google Drive doesn't show up in the connector list at all
troubleshooting.cause: On Team and Enterprise plans, an Owner has to enable Google Drive for the whole workspace before it appears for individual members.
troubleshooting.fix: Ask an Owner or Primary Owner to add it under the organization's connector settings.

faq.question: Is the Google Drive connector read-only?
faq.answer: No. Claude can search your Drive, read the files it finds, and create new files there. It is a broader permission than a simple viewer grant, so it's worth reading the Google consent screen rather than clicking through it.

faq.question: Where do I find the Google Drive connector in Claude?
faq.answer: Under Customize > Connectors, not Settings. Select Connect next to Google Drive and sign in with the Google account you want Claude to reach.

faq.question: Do I need to turn the connector on every time?
faq.answer: You connect the account once, but you still turn it on per conversation from the + menu under Connectors, so Claude only searches Drive in chats where you've enabled it.

faq.question: What's the difference between the connector and "Add from Google Drive"?
faq.answer: The connector lets Claude search Drive on its own inside a conversation. Add from Google Drive attaches one specific file you pick by name or URL, which also works for adding a file to a private project's knowledge.

faq.question: Can I use this in a shared project?
faq.answer: You can use the connector in a shared conversation, but adding a Drive file to a shared project's knowledge base is disabled — that only works in a private project.

verifiedNote: Click path and screens come from a walkthrough recorded in July 2025. The connector location, permission scope, file-type support, and reconnect steps were re-checked against Claude's official documentation and Help Center in September 2026. That check corrected two things this guide previously got wrong: the connector lives under Customize, not Settings, and it can create new files in Drive rather than only reading them.
